model_annotation: This plot illustrates the coverage of a process as a function of the number of completions. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (k)” and uses a logarithmic scale with values ranging from 2⁰ to 2^28, marked with tick intervals of 1 in increments of 2^n, where n is an integer. The y-axis is linear and ranges from 0.7 to 0.8, with values marked at intervals of 0.02. Three lines are displayed: a solid blue line with triangle markers, labeled “Llama-3B,” which begins at approximately 0.7 and increases steadily to a value of approximately 0.8 at k=28; a dashed green line with square markers, labeled “Llama-3B + FT,” which starts at approximately 0.4 and increases to approximately 0.75 at k=28; a dotted cyan line with diamond markers, labeled “Llama-1B,” which begins at approximately 0.4 and increases to approximately 0.65 at k=28; and a dashed cyan line with triangle markers, labeled “Llama-1B + FT,” which starts at approximately 0.35 and increases to approximately 0.6 at k=28.
